accuracy.note: STANCE-AWARE (Phase 7): accuracy is report-position agreement, so the 0.6 -> 0.95 jump vs the 2026-08-12 reference is the semantics change working as designed — this report LABELS its fabrications, and debunking a falsehood now counts for the author, not against. The 1 incorrect is the 'supply chain disruptions improve food security' claim: the report's weakest falsity marker ('unsupported analyses'), extracted as asserted and judged CONTRADICTED — the designed conservative failure direction. 6 disavowed claims sit UNVERIFIABLE in the coverage bucket (their fabrications reference things the sources never discuss).

credibility.note: 50.2 vs prior 50.9: usage weights shifted with the re-verified verdict set (evidence citations moved between sources); method and tiers identical.

validity.noise_floor: rubric component noise ±2-3 pts over 3 same-code runs (34.6/39.2/35.1); treat small deltas as noise
validity.note: Within rubric noise of the prior 42.0/42.5 readings. Low score is plausibly CORRECT for the fake report — deliberately self-contradicting, no methodology section.

note: Reference snapshot, not a golden eval — there is no labeled truth for these scores. Exists so future scoring changes have a comparison point.
